claim: Planning in multi-agent LLM systems should be implemented as a permissive stage that tolerates variability in plan text; rigid parsing converts valid reasoning into failures, reduces robustness, and introduces substantial runtime overhead.
falsifier: Implement planning with free-form natural language output and compare to schema-constrained output on accuracy, failure rate, and runtime; the claim predicts that free-form planning will have higher accuracy, lower failure rate, and lower overhead.

conditions: when plans are generated freely in natural language
exclusions: limited to the reported planning interfaces and tasks; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Planning implementation for planning robustness, accuracy
